## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: graduated licensing and restrictions
Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 14 to 17; part C2 holds 10 confusable-pair blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-GDL-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-GDL-D-SUP — Level Two supervising-driver seating applied to supervised hours (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NC-GDL-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-GDL-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the federal-identification document date and the online upgrade option (sec02-F24, sec02-F42) can change and must be refreshed from the DMV website.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E
